text: Make offerings to God through people. When you do a good deed, especially anonymously, you perform not merely a good act, but an act of service devoid of selfish desires. In such moments, extend with your attention the connection between your action and God, and your action will turn into an offering on the altar of the universe. And the response to your action will come not as human gratitude or monetary tokens (as usually happens), but as pure divine grace.
